newsitem.title: USA: China buys 35,000 tonnes of US soyoil-US exporters.
newsitem.headline: China buys 35,000 tonnes of US soyoil-US exporters.

text.p: China on Monday purchased a total of 35,000 tonnes of U.S. soyoil for February shipment, U.S. exporters said.

One position for 25,000 tonnes was slated for shipment from the U.S. Gulf for approximately $512.00 per tonne FOB, and the other 10,000 tonnes were slated for shipment from Norfolk at approximately $510.00 a tonne FOB, exporters said.
The U.S. soyoil purchases come on the heels of active Chinese buying in South American vegetable oil markets.
China is estimated to have purchased 50,000 to 60,000 tonnes of vegetable oil from Brazil and Argentina over the past several days, U.S. exporters said.
"I think they're trying to get some business on the books before the Chinese New Year begins on Friday," said a U.S. exporter.
The exporter said that U.S. soyoil prices were becoming more attractive to foreign buyers, so additional business could be expected on Chicago Board of Trade market breaks.
"The bottom line is, anytime you get near the $500.000 per tonne level, they (Chinese importers) are going to be there with open arms," he said.
